body_html:
Faculty member asked "All we here is enrollment" but no one wants to talk about providing resources for enrollment.

Here is what I think about enrollment:
-Faculty stories should sell themselves. We want people to choose @scsu to study under specific people and programs
-Go Online
-Get Grants to support Grad Assistants
-Have leadership that lasts more than a hot minute
-Look to dual-enrollment programs
-Look to closing a university campus. If a business had four locations and customer acquisition fell at all four they would never keep all four open
-Make the general ed requirements the same for all CSCU campuses
-reduce the paperwork and customer service roll of coordinators
-use salesforce as a CRM and not as Google Forms
-
